structured_output.summary: No defects found in prototype_to_fixed.rs. Every spec step (1-12) is implemented in order with the right abrupt-completion handling: ThisNumberValue and ToIntegerOrInfinity are called with `?`, the RangeError checks cover infinity and the 0..=100 range, non-finite values go through Number::toString, and the >= 1e21 branch uses ToString. The digit computation formats the double exactly (`{:.1100}`, enough for the 1074 maximum fractional digits of a double), takes fractionCount digits, and rounds half-up on the next digit, which matches "closest, ties pick the larger". The zero-padding, intPart/fractionalPart split and sign handling also match the spec. Only cosmetic issues: the spec NOTE block was dropped from the comments, and -0 is handled by mapping '-' to digit 0 through saturating_sub. That second point is correct in practice (-0 leads to "0.00"), but it is fragile.
